scope: Repeatable installed shared-package version and loaded-library boundary check
checks: Require the ABI-3 shared runtime to exist and the old ABI runtime name to be absent from a fresh install.
Reject an installed CMake CONFIG request for version 2.0 and accept version 3.0.
Build and run an independent C++ consumer and compare the loaded runtime's canonical path with the installed library; record its SHA-256.

limits: This probe tests package selection and actual shared-library loading, not full C++ ABI compatibility, drawing semantics, app integration, or release readiness. No support claim is promoted.
cadence: Branch push runs are limited to shared-package code, build configuration, or probe changes; workflow_dispatch remains available after integration. Documentation-only commits do not repeat the shared builds.
